31. (Currently amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, __wherein the first balloon and second balloon are positioned in spaced relation within the gastric cavity such that the conduit extends between them along an axial direction__.

32. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel, __wherein the first, second, and third lumens are configured to extend independently through the conduit without fluid communication between the first and second lumens__.

33. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length, __and wherein the instrument throughput channel is sized and configured to receive a guide wire or therapeutic instrument of a specified diameter range__.

34. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism configured to facilitate engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity via the esophagus, __wherein the coupling mechanism comprises at least one of a plug, a suture loop, or a tether configured to mechanically engage the retrieval device__.

35. (Previously presented) The system of claim 31 wherein the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon.

36. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about 10-40 mm, __wherein the inter-balloon section maintains structural rigidity to prevent contact between the first and second balloons when inflated__.

41. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state, __wherein the delivery catheter comprises a tubular sheath that maintains the gastric space filler in a compressed configuration during insertion through the esophagus__.

42. (Currently amended) A gastric space filler system, comprising: a conduit having a first end and a second end opposite the first end, wherein the first end is operably coupled to a first balloon and the second end is operably coupled to a second balloon; a first lumen through the conduit, wherein the lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the first balloon; a second lumen through the conduit, wherein the second lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the second balloon; and a third lumen extending through the conduit, wherein the third lumen is configured for instrument throughput, __wherein the first, second, and third lumens are structurally isolated from one another to prevent cross-contamination of fluids and instruments__.

43. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein: the first lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the first balloon; and the second lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the second balloon, __and wherein the first and second lumens are configured to allow independent inflation and deflation of the first and second balloons__.

44. (Previously presented) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the third lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to a second end of the conduit.

45. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42, further comprising a coupling mechanism at the first end of the conduit, wherein the coupling mechanism is configured for instrument throughput into the third lumen and configured to couple to a delivery catheter and/or a filling tube, __wherein the coupling mechanism comprises a hub structure with distinct ports for the first lumen, second lumen, and third lumen__.

46. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the gastric space filler system is configured for delivery through an esophagus of a patient to a stomach of the patient, __wherein the system is configured to be delivered in a minimally invasive endoscopic procedure__.

47. (Currently amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the conduit is configured for attachment to a delivery catheter, and wherein the third lumen of the conduit is configured to receive an instrument passed through the delivery catheter, __wherein the third lumen has a diameter sufficient to accommodate passage of a guide wire or endoscopic instrument__.
